_README: 14 A2 card(s) with no English definition at all.
Author "def": what the thing IS, in one learner-facing clause — not a list
of other translations, which the `en` gloss already gives.
`defDe` and `example` are sense evidence, not text to translate: use them to
confirm which homograph the card is about, then write the English yourself.
"expect" is what the corpus holds now; fix-authored.ts refuses a stale row.

rows.defDe: meist ohne Artikel: Reiseaufenthalt mit Frühstück, Mittagessen und Abendessen
rows.example: Wir buchen das Hotel mit Vollpension.
rows.def: A hotel booking that includes breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Belonging to the person spoken about and to nobody else.

rows.defDe: die Geh- oder Fahrtrichtung verlassen und nach rechts oder links in einen anderen Verkehrsweg schwenken
rows.example: Biegen Sie links in die Hauptstraße ein.
rows.def: To leave the road you are on and turn into another one.

rows.defDe: in einem Theaterstück / Film Schauspieler sein
rows.example: Geld spielt bei dieser Entscheidung keine Rolle.
rows.def: To matter — to be one of the things that influences a decision or an outcome.

rows.defDe: to fall; to drop; to die; to fall in battle; to die in battle; to be killed in action
rows.def: To drop downwards under its own weight, or to come down suddenly.

rows.example: Das Hotel liegt gegenüber dem Park.
rows.def: On the other side, directly facing something across a street or a space.

rows.example: Markieren Sie bitte die richtige Lösung.
rows.def: To make a mark on something so it stands out or can be found again.

rows.defDe: Kleidungsstück, das um den Körper geschlungen wird
rows.def: Of a pale blue-green colour, like mint leaves.

rows.example: Plötzlich fing es an zu regnen.
rows.def: Happening all at once, with no warning.
To talk with someone, less formal and less prepared than sprechen.
To arrange in advance that a seat, table or room is held for you.
To be true or accurate — said of figures, facts and statements.

rows.defDe: auf einem speziell dafür konzipierten Brett (Surfboard/Surfbrett) im Stehen sich balancierend von den Brandungswellen ans Ufer tragen lassen; Surfing betreiben
rows.example: Am Meer kann man gut surfen.
rows.def: To ride breaking waves standing on a board; also to move from page to page online.

rows.defDe: etwas (räumlich) länger machen; die (räumliche) Ausdehnung von etwas erhöhen
rows.def: To make something longer in space or in time, including renewing a document past its expiry.
